title: Joey Porter happy for fresh start with Cowboys, eyes Sunday debut - ESPN
description: Joey Porter Jr. says he hopes to make his debut for the Cowboys on Sunday, when they play the Texans.

title: Chris Hansen on Primetime Ending, A24 Legal Action: They Exploited Me - Variety
description: The film 'Primetime' depicts the show 'To Catch a Predator' and its host, Chris Hansen. But he says that nearly everything in it is untrue.
